WPSS No.1493 of 2022 
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State.
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4. Counter affidavit and supplementary 
counter affidavit filed on behalf of the 
respondent no.3 are taken on record. Misc. 
applications (IA Nos.1/2022 & 3/2023) stand 
disposed of accordingly.
5. Rejoinder affidavit is also taken on 
record. Misc. application (IA No.2/2022) 
stands disposed of.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that there is no need to file any 
supplementary rejoinder to the 
supplementary counter for the reason that by 
means of the supplementary counter only this 
one has to be informed by the respondent￾State that petitioner has been given further 
promotion on the post of Head Assistant 
(Mukhya Sahayak). 
7. Since the pleadings in the writ petition 
have been completed, the matter is fixed for 
final hearing on 18.12.2023.
 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
